senses.gloss:
Yukta (EI 8-3; HD), an officer in general; also an official designation (CII, Vol. 1, p. 4); the word used in Rock Edict III of Aśoka is explained by some scholars as the designation of a class of officers, although there also the word may be understood in the sense of ‘an officer’; but it is an official designation [] in passages like yukta-niyukta-vāsāvak-ādhikārika (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXI, p. 144) where it may be the same as Āyuktaka.
 Cf. Yuktaka, Āyukta, etc.
Yuktaka (IE 8-3; HD), same as Yukta, Āyukta or Āyuktaka. See Ep. Ind., Vol. VII, pp. 26, 39-40.
